# FirstStep Child Specialist Clinic

> A professional pediatric clinic in Kuala Lumpur and Petaling Jaya offering comprehensive child healthcare services by experienced pediatricians.

FirstStep Child Specialist Clinic is a trusted pediatric healthcare provider located at Plaza Damas 3 in Sri Hartamas, serving families across the Klang Valley with specialized care for infants and children. The clinic is led by Consultant Pediatricians Dr. JoAnn Rajah, Dr. Soo Hui Fang, and Dr. Charlotte Gan, offering services including vaccinations, developmental assessments, allergy testing, and nutritionist consultations.
